item.title: Corps news roundup: Phantom Regiment heads west, Gold names design staff, Cavaliers tap new education director
item.description:
DCI's latest corps news roundup is out. Headline items: Phantom Regiment is heading to California in 2027, a notable westward move for the corps; Gold has introduced its 2027 design staff, locking in the creative team behind next season's production; and the Cavaliers have named a new education director.

The roundup also includes updates on DCI All-Age and SoundSport, plus additional corps announcements — including notes on 7th Regiment. It's a standard offseason digest: roster and staffing moves now, show concepts and tour details later. For corps followers, the Phantom Regiment California trip and the Gold design hires are the items to watch, since design staff choices typically signal each corps' competitive direction for the coming season.
